name: new-moon-app
description: A Midnight Network application created with create-mn-app

scripts.compile: wsl bash -c "cd /home/rudra/new-moon-app && export PATH='/home/rudra/.local/bin:\$PATH' && npm run compile && rsync -av --delete /home/rudra/new-moon-app/contracts/managed/ ./contracts/managed/"
scripts.setup: wsl bash -c "cd /home/rudra/new-moon-app && npm run setup && cp /home/rudra/new-moon-app/.midnight-state.json ./.midnight-state.json && rsync -av --delete /home/rudra/new-moon-app/.midnight-wallet-state/ ./.midnight-wallet-state/"
scripts.deploy: wsl bash -c "cd /home/rudra/new-moon-app && npm run deploy && cp /home/rudra/new-moon-app/.midnight-state.json ./.midnight-state.json && rsync -av --delete /home/rudra/new-moon-app/.midnight-wallet-state/ ./.midnight-wallet-state/"
scripts.clean: wsl bash -c "cd /home/rudra/new-moon-app && npm run clean" && rm -rf contracts/managed .midnight-state.json .midnight-wallet-state
